Focuses on iterative self-refinement cycles for decision-making in topology optimization, particularly effective for under-represented problem classes with sparse literature coverage [1].

## Communication Flow Dynamics in Agent Collaboration
Addresses communication flow as the primary determinant of success, identifying early agreements as a failure mechanism and proposing their removal to improve task success rates [2].

## Unified Multi-Task Frameworks with Parameter-Efficient Adaptation
Integrates semantic state serialization and MoE-LoRA adapter architecture for parameter-efficient knowledge sharing across multiple wireless communication tasks without additional training [3].
